title: Service Specification, Inclusions Annex: What Each Northbeam Fulfilment Service Includes at the Door
content:
The inclusions annex to the specification of Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment records, service by service,
whether installation is part of the fulfilment service, whether taking the old item away is part of it, how many old
items are taken away at no charge on one delivery, whether the old item is disconnected before it is taken away, and
whether water, waste or gas connections are made on the new item at delivery.

| Fulfilment service | Installation part of the service | Haul-away part of the service | Old items taken at no charge on one delivery | Old item disconnected first | Water, waste or gas connections made |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Parcel Delivery | no | no | 0 | no | no |
| Store Pickup Hold | no | no | 0 | no | no |
| Threshold Delivery | no | no | 0 | no | no |
| Room of Choice Delivery with Haul Away | no | yes | 1 | yes | no |
| White Glove Delivery and Installation | yes | yes | 2 | yes | yes |
| Business Dock and Freight Delivery | no | no | 0 | no | no |

The money side of the same annex: the installation charge is the charge for installing the goods where installation
is bought; the haul-away charge is the charge to take the old item away; the recycling charge is the statutory
recycling charge collected on the goods.

| Fulfilment service | Installation charge | Haul-away charge | Statutory recycling charge |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Parcel Delivery | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Store Pickup Hold | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Threshold Delivery | 0.00 | 39.00 | 12.00 |
| Room of Choice Delivery with Haul Away | 0.00 | 0.00 | 12.00 |
| White Glove Delivery and Installation | 0.00 | 0.00 | 18.00 |
| Business Dock and Freight Delivery | 0.00 | 25.00 | 15.00 |

## Points of judgement on the annex

**How many old items does a service take at no charge?** None on four of the six services, one on Room of Choice
Delivery with Haul Away, and two on White Glove Delivery and Installation.

**What is the installation charge on each service?** It stands at 0.00 on all six services of Northbeam Purchase
Orders and Fulfilment.

**Which services carry a recycling charge?** Threshold Delivery and Room of Choice Delivery with Haul Away at 12.00,
Business Dock and Freight Delivery at 15.00, and White Glove Delivery and Installation at 18.00; the parcel and
collection services carry 0.00.
